## My Cycle 1.1.4

### Maintenance and code quality
- Completed a repository-wide cleanup and deep refactoring pass while preserving the existing app behavior, UI/UX, data formats and Android application identity.
- Removed unused Compose tooling dependencies, redundant calendar state and calculations, an unused range-observation API, and unnecessary Activity lookup code.
- Simplified Room deletion by date and reused the existing atomic batch API for debug-only RuStore screenshot seed data.
- Kept the prediction, cycle-history, attention-note, persistence and release-signing behavior unchanged.

### Quality and supply-chain checks
- Stabilized Qodana Android project import without disabling strict Gradle dependency verification or lowering the Qodana quality gate.
- Qodana now prepares the same JDK/Gradle project environment used by CI, analyzes the current pull-request head with `pr-mode: false`, and treats only IDE-only source/documentation attachments separately from executable dependencies.
- Android CI, CodeQL, Semgrep and Gitleaks remain part of the release quality gate.

This is a maintenance release with no intended user-facing feature changes. The permanent Android Application ID / Bundle ID remains `com.sl.mycycle`, and the app remains offline-first with no account, analytics, ads or Android `INTERNET` permission.
